, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there lived a small bug. The bug was sad because he wanted to go up the mountain. He was frustrated because he was too small to go up.
One day, a big bird came to the mountain. The bird saw the bug and wanted to help. The bird picked up the bug and flew up to the top of the mountain. The bug was so happy and said, "Thank you, bird!"
But then, a mean bird saw the bug and wanted to eat the bug. The bird tried to fly away, but the bug was too fast. The bird ate the bug, and the bug was gone. The bug and the bird were both sad and hungry.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her soft toy cat. She would take the cat everywhere she went. Lucy and her cat had a lot of fun together.
One sunny day, Lucy and her cat went to the park to play. They saw a big tree and decided to climb it. Lucy put her soft cat on the ground and started to climb. But as she climbed higher and higher, the wind blew her toy cat away.
Lucy was sad and began to cry. Her cat tried to comfort her, but Lucy felt hurt and cried even more. She climbed down the tree and went home. From that day on, Lucy never forgot her soft cat and always remembered to be careful when climbing trees.
